resources.title: NIST Manufacturing
resources.provider: National Institute of Standards and Technology
resources.notes: Primary NIST manufacturing portal covering measurement science, quality, systems, robotics, supply chains and sustainable manufacturing. Broad portal mappings remain conservative and do not imply every item covers every mapped level.

resources.title: NIST Smart Manufacturing
resources.provider: National Institute of Standards and Technology
resources.notes: NIST research on additive manufacturing measurement, robotics, model-based enterprise, trustworthy systems and smart manufacturing.

resources.title: NIST Manufacturing Systems Design and Analysis
resources.provider: National Institute of Standards and Technology
resources.notes: NIST manufacturing systems design, analysis, modeling, investment and test-bed resources.

resources.title: NIST Digital Thread for Smart Manufacturing
resources.provider: National Institute of Standards and Technology
resources.notes: Reference material for model-based engineering, product/manufacturing information, CAD/CAM, inspection interoperability and digital-thread implementation.

resources.title: DOE Advanced Materials and Manufacturing Technologies Office
resources.notes: Current DOE advanced materials and manufacturing program portal, including explainers, project data and a resource library.
